history.summary: A 28-unit freehold boutique block off Eunos with essentially no usable liquidity — only 9 URA transactions and no project-level appreciation data — and the $1,481 psf asking sits at the very top of the project's historical $1,087-$1,575 range. The freehold tenure cannot offset the thin exit and full-price entry for a 5-7yr investment.
history.rating_rationale: 742sqft 2BR at $1.099M / $1,481 psf is at the ceiling of this development's own transaction band ($1,087-$1,575), leaving zero margin. With only 28 units and 9 URA transactions, resale could take many months and price discovery is unreliable (no appreciation data at all). Off-frontier (MMR 1550 / score 806 leans on a 2.79% resale rate). Freehold and a 12-min Kembangan walk are minor positives that don't rescue the illiquidity-plus-top-of-range combination for an investment hold.
red_flags: Only 28 units and 9 URA transactions — severely illiquid, unreliable pricing
Asking psf at the top of the project's historical range (no margin)
No project-level appreciation data (regional baseline only)
Boutique block with minimal facilities limits owner-occupier/tenant appeal
catalysts: ~12min walk to Kembangan EW6, near Eunos amenities

history.summary: Tiny 28-unit freehold boutique block at 88 Lorong Marican, D14. The eye-catching -18.9% 'cheap' signal rests on essentially no data (1 cohort txn, regional-baseline appreciation, 9 txns) and is most likely a data quirk.
history.rating_rationale: psf_cohort_txns = 1 and appreciation is a regional_baseline fallback (not real project CAGR) over just 9 txns — exactly the thin-data quirk v3.4 says to distrust. Web data shows the project trades roughly $1,087-$1,575 psf with a recent high of $1,575 psf (Dec 2025, a 441 sqft unit); the larger 742 sqft 2BR at $1,481 psf ($1,099k) is plausible but far from a screaming bargain once you account for small units pulling PSF up. Freehold is not a forward edge. 28-unit boutique = thin liquidity and weak facilities. No dated catalyst; D14 RCR baseline (~+3.5%) is the realistic forward.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns = 1 and appreciation_source = regional_baseline (9 txns) — the -18.9% cheapness is statistically unreliable
28-unit boutique block: thin resale liquidity, minimal facilities, exit risk on a 5-7yr hold
Project's recent realized PSF (~$1,087-$1,575) does not corroborate a deep discount at $1,481 psf
Geylang fringe (Lorong Marican) locale; financing/stigma considerations
catalysts: Freehold and quiet boutique setting (livability appeal, not a price edge)
Kembangan/Eunos EWL access ~ walkable; broad Paya Lebar rejuvenation
